flags.message: The first 'relist' (distributed 10/7 for 11/6 after the 9/28 conference) appears to be a deferral pending companion petition No. 26-353 (petitioner's motion to defer and 9/17 letter). It is not a post-conference relist signal, so the elevated band likely overstates grant odds. 26-353 is not Vide-linked in the snapshot.
